Caroline attends an LGBTQ support group
nodes.body: Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group meeting on 2023-05-07, which she described as 'so powerful'. She finds the transgender stories especially inspiring. The support group has made her feel accepted and given her courage to embrace herself.

nodes.header: Caroline is continuing her education and exploring career options
nodes.body: Caroline said: 'Gonna continue my edu and check out career options, which is pretty exciting!' She is actively researching after the LGBTQ support group experience motivated her.

nodes.header: Caroline is interested in counseling or mental health careers
nodes.body: Caroline wants to pursue counseling and mental health as a career, with a specific focus on working with transgender people. On 2023-05-08 she said: 'I'm keen on counseling or working in mental health - I'd love to support those with similar issues.' On 2023-06-27 she clarified her specific focus: 'I'm thinking of working with trans people, helping them accept themselves and supporting their mental health.' She said her motivation comes from her own journey: 'I saw how counseling and support groups improved my life, so I started caring more about mental health and understanding myself. Now I'm passionate about creating a safe, inviting place for people to grow.' On 2023-07-03, after attending a pride parade, she reaffirmed: 'Talking to the community made me want to use my story to help others too - I'm still thinking that counseling and mental health is the way to go. I'm super excited to give back.' On 2023-07-06 she restated her ongoing commitment: 'I've been looking into counseling or mental health work more. I'm passionate about helping people and making a positive impact. It's tough, but really rewarding too.' On 2023-07-12 after her LGBTQ conference experience she said: 'I'm still looking into counseling and mental health jobs. It's important to me that people have someone to talk to, and I want to help make that happen.' She elaborated on her motivation: 'I struggled with mental health, and support I got was really helpful. It made me realize how important it is for others to have a support system. So, I started looking into counseling and mental health career options, so I could help other people on their own journeys like I was helped.'

nodes.header: Melanie has multiple children and is busy with kids and work
nodes.body: Melanie said she is 'swamped with the kids & work.' She has multiple children — she mentioned going swimming with 'the kids' (plural). She has a son (older than her youngest daughter) and a youngest daughter. On 2023-06-27 she described 'the 2 younger kids love nature' during a recent camping trip, implying at least 3 children total, with 2 of them being notably younger.

nodes.header: Melanie paints as a creative outlet for expression and relaxation
nodes.body: Melanie said: 'Painting's a fun way to express my feelings and get creative. It's a great way to relax after a long day.' She uses painting as an emotional outlet.

nodes.header: Melanie painted a lake sunrise in 2022 that is special to her
nodes.body: Melanie painted a lake sunrise in 2022 (referred to as 'last year' in May 2023). She said: 'Yeah, I painted that lake sunrise last year! It's special to me.' Caroline initially described it as a 'sunset over a lake' but Melanie corrected it to a sunrise.

nodes.header: Caroline and Melanie
Caroline and Melanie are close friends who catch up regularly
nodes.body: Caroline and Melanie are friends who keep in touch and share personal updates over the months. On 2023-05-08 they greeted each other with 'Good to see you!' and exchanged warm encouragement (Melanie told Caroline 'You've got guts' and 'You'd be a great counselor'). They share images and creative work — Melanie showed Caroline her lake sunrise painting on 2023-05-08, and Caroline shared her trans-experience paintings (including 'Embracing Identity') on 2023-08-14. On 2023-05-25 (Session 2) they caught up again: Melanie opened with news that she had run a charity race for mental health the prior Saturday (2023-05-20) and reflected that the event sparked a commitment to daily self-care — she is carving out me-time each day for running, reading, or playing violin to stay refreshed for her family; Melanie mentioned her kids are excited for summer break and the family is planning a camping trip in June 2023; Caroline revealed she's researching adoption agencies to fulfill her dream of giving kids a loving home, shared a photo of an agency she's considering, and explained she chose it specifically because it supports LGBTQ+ adopters (inclusivity really spoke to her); Caroline also confirmed she plans to adopt as a single parent, calling it tough but saying 'I'm up for the challenge.' On 2023-06-09 (Session 3) Caroline opened with big news — she'd given a school talk 'last week' (~2023-06-02) about her transgender journey and encouraging students to get involved in the LGBTQ community ('It was awesome... I felt super powerful giving my talk'); reflecting on it made her realize how far she'd come since starting her transition three years earlier (~2020); they also shared what motivates them — Caroline shared a photo of her support friend meetup (a family in a yard) and explained she's known these friends for 4 years, ever since she moved from her home country, crediting them for supporting her through a tough breakup; Melanie shared she draws motivation from her husband and kids, shared a waterfall photo of her husband and daughter, shared her wedding photo announcing she's been married 5 years (since ~2018), and shared a photo of a fun family day playing games and eating on a blanket. On 2023-07-15 (Session 8) they caught up again with an update-focused chat: Melanie opened with news that she'd taken her kids to a pottery workshop the prior Friday (2023-07-14) where they all made their own pots and one kid made a cup with a dog face; Melanie shared a sunset/palm tree nature painting she and her kids made together the previous weekend (~2023-07-08); Caroline announced she'd attended an adoption council meeting on 2023-07-14 that was 'inspiring and emotional' and made her 'even more determined to adopt'; Melanie shared a photo of a blue vase with sunflowers and roses, prompting Caroline to reveal blue is her favorite color ('makes me feel relaxed') and sparking a discussion about flower meanings (sunflowers=warmth/happiness, roses=love/beauty, flowers=joy/growth/beauty for Melanie); Melanie reminisced about her greenhouse wedding ceremony (full of love and joy, marrying her partner being the best part), sharing wedding photos; Caroline shared her pride parade experience from a few weeks earlier (~2023-06-25) reflecting that she felt 'so accepted and happy' and realized 'having the courage to transition was the best part' — 'it's so freeing to express myself authentically'; Melanie revealed her family helped her through a recent move with lots of love and support, mentioning another recent family camping trip in the forest; they discussed Melanie's family hiking in mountains and exploring forests as a favorite shared activity. On 2023-07-17 (Session 9) they caught up again: Melanie opened sharing she had a quiet weekend after taking her family camping two weekends ago (~2023-07-08/09) where she enjoyed unplugging and hanging with her kids; Caroline announced she had joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth the previous weekend (~2023-07-16) and finds it 'really rewarding to help the community'; Caroline revealed she mentors a transgender teen 'just like me' and they've been working on building up confidence and positive strategies together (''really paying off!''); Caroline shared that she and her mentee had a great time at the June 2023 LGBT pride event, with her best moment being 'seeing my mentee's face light up when they saw the support'; Caroline announced her upcoming LGBTQ art show 'next month' (planned August 2023, later rescheduled to September) and shared a photo of her painting for the show — a tree with a bright sun in the background, inspired by a visit to an LGBTQ center and meant to capture community 'unity and strength'; Melanie closed by mentioning she and her kids just finished another painting similar to their prior sunset/palm tree piece. They reconnected again on 2023-07-20 ('Just wanted to say hi!') with another life-update chat: Caroline shared joining the LGBTQ activist group 'Connected LGBTQ Activists,' Melanie shared family stories (recent beach trip, annual camping tradition, 2022 Perseid meteor shower memory, her youngest's first steps). On 2023-08-14 Caroline shared attending a pride parade and Melanie shared her daughter's birthday concert. On 2023-08-17 Caroline shared an upsetting hike encounter with religious conservatives and Melanie showed off her newly finished colorful pottery bowl; they agreed to plan a summer 2023 trip just the two of them to explore nature. On 2023-08-23 they caught up again: Caroline announced she applied to adoption agencies to become a mom, they exchanged pet updates (Caroline's guinea pig Oscar, Melanie's dog Oliver and new cat Bailey, plus the funny story of Oliver hiding a bone in Melanie's slipper), bonded over love of horses (Caroline's childhood horseback riding with her dad, Melanie's horse painting and carrot-feeding story), and shared recent artwork (Melanie's horse painting on a wooden wall, Caroline's blue-faced self-portrait); Melanie wished Caroline 'the best on your adoption journey.' On 2023-08-25 they caught up again with an art-focused chat: Caroline opened by sharing another bad hiking encounter (she'd apologized to the people involved); Melanie showed off a pottery plate with flowers made in pottery class the day before; Caroline shared a sunset painting inspired by a recent beach visit; Melanie shared her family's day volunteering at a homeless shelter; Caroline spoke about her trans journey, the meaning of community murals (rainbow flags, eagles), and shared multiple stained glass pieces she made (including one about 'the key to discovering our true potential' and a large church commission on time and change); Caroline also shared a flower bouquet drawing and a rainbow sidewalk she found on a Pride Month walk; Melanie shared her recent sunflower painting and mentioned planning autumn-inspired paintings; Caroline announced she's organizing an LGBTQ art show for September 2023 to feature LGBTQ artists. On 2023-08-28 they caught up again with a music-focused chat: Melanie opened sharing that she'd taken her kids to a playground the day before (2023-08-27); Caroline shared that she'd recently volunteered at an LGBTQ+ youth center and found it 'powerful, emotional' to share her own story with the young people, and announced she's organizing a talent show at the youth center for September 2023; Melanie shared she'd attended a 'Summer Sounds' band concert (pop music) and reflected on how music brings people together; they discovered they both play instruments — Caroline plays acoustic guitar (started ~2018, ~5 years ago) for emotional expression, and Melanie plays clarinet (started when young) for expression and relaxation (Melanie had earlier mentioned violin on 2023-05-25, so she plays both); Caroline shared 'Brave' by Sara Bareilles as her most meaningful song reflecting her journey of courage, and Melanie shared her music tastes spanning classical (Bach, Mozart) and modern (Ed Sheeran's 'Perfect'). On 2023-09-13 they caught up again ('long time no chat'): Caroline opened sharing her weekend biking outing with 'the gang' and a beach sunset photo; Melanie shared a recent family camping trip with kids in a forest (with yellow leaves, hiking, marshmallows, stories around the campfire); Caroline shared a heart painting she made and reflected on how LGBTQ+ volunteering inspires her art; they compared their art origins — Caroline's been making art since around age 17 (empowering and cathartic), Melanie for 7 years with painting and pottery as her 'real muses' (both creative outlet and form of therapy); Melanie shared photo of her pottery bowls; Caroline shared her red-and-blue painting symbolizing her journey beyond the binary gender system (red/blue = binary, mixed colors = smashing rigid thinking) and said she's 'finally proud of who I am'; Caroline opened up about how her transition reshaped her friendships — some close friends stayed supportive, others couldn't handle it, and now her remaining relationships feel more genuine; Melanie shared about a recent café visit with a thoughtful safety sign on the door (Caroline was briefly concerned but Melanie reassured her). On 2023-10-13 they caught up with a cluster of updates: Caroline shared attending a transgender poetry reading the prior Friday and shared event photos; Caroline contacted her adoption mentor and declared she's ready to be a mom; Melanie shared her buddy adopted last year and said she might do it too; Caroline walked Melanie through a four-step adoption-getting-started workflow; Melanie told Caroline about her pottery-break injury; Caroline shared her drawing of a woman in a dress symbolizing freedom; Melanie shared her pink-sky sunset painting and a blue-background abstract painting; Caroline shared she's been trying abstract art. On 2023-10-20 Melanie shared stories from a family roadtrip — her son's car accident (he was OK), Grand Canyon cliff photo of her kids, camping sunset, reflections that family is her rock, and a nature trail walk photo with kids. On 2023-10-22 (Session 19) Caroline opened with the big news she'd passed her adoption agency interviews last Friday (2023-10-20); Melanie shared her newly bought wooden doll figurines photo reminding her of family love and asked Caroline's vision; Caroline described wanting to give kids without homes a safe loving family; Caroline reflected on friends, family, and role models supporting her through transition; Caroline said she finds joy in passing that support forward to others; they celebrated freedom in being authentic and shared a clock photo and a 'happiness' painting photo. They previously attended Pride fest together in 2022 with 'the whole gang.' Melanie consistently affirms Caroline's identity and advocacy ('Your art's amazing... I love how you use it to tell your stories and teach people about trans folks'; 'I'm in awe of your courage as a trans person'; 'I'm super proud of you for being your true self'). They consistently exchange photos and draw emotional support from each other ('You make life's struggles more bearable').

nodes.header: Caroline shared support group experience and career plans with Melanie (2023-05-08)

nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-05-08. Melanie shared an image of a painting of a sunrise over a lake during her chat with Caroline. nodes.header: Caroline joined the LGBTQ activist group 'Connected LGBTQ Activists' on 2023-07-11
nodes.body: Caroline said: 'I just joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues' (2023-07-11). The group is called 'Connected LGBTQ Activists' and is 'made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes.' They have regular meetings, plan events and campaigns, and support each other. Caroline finds it fulfilling and says it lets her give her voice and 'make a real difference.' She is meeting 'so many cool people who are as passionate as I am about rights and community support.'

nodes.header: Caroline is passionate about LGBTQ rights, equality, and community advocacy
nodes.body: Caroline is deeply passionate about LGBTQ+ rights, equality, and community advocacy. She described herself and her activist group members as 'passionate as I am about rights and community support.' She finds activism fulfilling because it lets her use her voice to 'make a real difference.' She attended a pride parade on 2023-08-11 in person and described it: 'so much energy and love everywhere. Really made me proud and reminded me how important it is to keep standing up for equality.' She also celebrates her city's 2023-07-15 pride parade: 'it was a powerful reminder that we are not alone in this fight for equality and inclusivity. Change is possible!' She values having 'our own platform to be ourselves and support others' rights' and uses her art as a channel for the same advocacy. On 2023-08-23 she summarized her personal mission: 'I want to live authentically and help others to do the same.' She also cited 'promoting LGBTQ rights and being true to myself' as sources of freedom alongside her art and supportive people.

nodes.header: Melanie's family takes beach trips once or twice a year
nodes.body: Melanie said about beach trips with her kids: 'We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year. But those times are always special to spend time together and chill.' She loves seeing her kids' faces happy at the beach — 'Seeing my kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best!'

nodes.header: Melanie's family has an annual summer camping tradition that is the highlight of summer
nodes.body: Melanie said: 'We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company. It's the highlight of our summer!' Her favorite camping memory is from 2022 when the family watched the Perseid meteor shower together — 'It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes and felt so at one with the universe. That's a memory I'll never forget.' The sky was 'so clear and filled with stars.' On 2023-10-20 she described her love of camping further: 'It's a chance to be present and together. We bond over stories, campfires and nature. It's so peaceful waking up to the sound of birds and the smell of fresh air - it always refreshes my soul.' Nature helps her reset and recharge, bringing peace and serenity to her soul.

nodes.header: Melanie's youngest child is a daughter whose first steps Melanie remembers vividly
nodes.body: Melanie said: 'I'll never forget the day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble as she took those initial steps really put into perspective how fleeting life is and how lucky I am to be able to share these moments.' Melanie's youngest is referred to as 'her,' indicating a daughter.

nodes.header: Melanie deeply values family bonds and feels grateful for moments with her family
nodes.body: Melanie repeatedly expressed gratitude for her family. She said: 'It's special moments like these that make me appreciate life and how lucky I am to be with my family and have our love.' Also: 'I'm really lucky to have my family; they bring so much joy and love.' Small moments — first steps, beach faces, campfire stories, meteor showers — make her 'feel tiny and in awe of the universe' and remind her how 'awesome life is.' After her son's car accident during the family roadtrip (2023-10-20 conversation), she said: 'Family's super important to me. Especially after the accident, I've thought a lot about how much I need them. They mean the world to me and I'm so thankful to have them' and 'They're my biggest motivation and support.' She describes her family as her 'rock' who give her strength to keep going and make hard times easier.

nodes.header: Melanie recalled 2022 Perseid meteor shower family camping trip to Caroline (2023-07-20)
nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-07-20. When Caroline asked about Melanie's best camping memory, Melanie shared the 2022 Perseid meteor shower trip: 'I'll always remember our camping trip last year when we saw the Perseid meteor shower. It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes and felt so at one with the universe. That's a memory I'll never forget.' She described the sky as 'so clear and filled with stars, and the meteor shower was amazing - it felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring.' Melanie said it was 'one of those moments where I felt tiny and in awe of the universe. Reminds me how awesome life is - so many little moments like that.'

nodes.header: Melanie recalled her youngest daughter's first steps to Caroline (2023-07-20)
nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-07-20. When Caroline asked about other memories that make her feel thankful, Melanie said: 'I'll never forget the day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble as she took those initial steps really put into perspective how fleeting life is and how lucky I am to be able to share these moments.' Caroline replied: 'Aw, that's sweet, Mel! Those milestones are great reminders of how special our bonds are.' Melanie added: 'Yeah, they sure are. It's special moments like these that make me appreciate life and how lucky I am to be with my family and have our love.'

nodes.header: Caroline is a trans woman
nodes.body: Caroline is a transgender woman. She began her gender transition around 2020 (she described it on 2023-06-09 as having started 'three years ago'). She said: 'My art is about expressing my trans experience. It's my way of showing my story and helping people understand the trans community.' She also said: 'Art's allowed me to explore my transition and my changing body. It's been a great way to work through stuff I'm going through.' This is consistent with her prior attendance at an LGBTQ support group where she was especially moved by the transgender stories.

nodes.header: Caroline's art practice
nodes.body: Caroline is a visual artist who creates paintings, stained glass, and drawings centered on her trans experience, self-acceptance, and LGBTQ+ advocacy. She uses art as a tool for self-discovery, healing, and community representation. Her work spans multiple media: oil/acrylic painting (sunsets, self-portraits, trans-identity pieces like 'Embracing Identity'), stained glass (church commissions with symbolic themes of growth, change, and 'the key to discovering our true potential'), and drawing (flowers are her favorite subject). On 2023-08-25 she said she would love to make a rainbow sidewalk mural next. She is organizing a September 2023 LGBTQ art show to feature LGBTQ artists and spread understanding and acceptance.

nodes.header: Caroline is a visual artist whose paintings express her trans experience
nodes.body: Caroline paints as her primary creative practice. She said: 'My art is about expressing my trans experience. It's my way of showing my story and helping people understand the trans community.' She shares paintings in conversation (e.g., shared painting images with Melanie on 2023-08-14 including one of 'a woman with a cow in her lap').

nodes.header: Caroline's painting 'Embracing Identity' depicts a woman on the journey of self-acceptance
nodes.body: Caroline painted a work titled 'Embracing Identity.' She described it: ''Embracing Identity' is all about finding comfort and love in being yourself. The woman in the painting stands for the journey of acceptance. My aim was to show warmth, love and self-acceptance.' The painting features a woman in a red shirt. Caroline shared an image of it with Melanie on 2023-08-14.

nodes.header: Caroline uses her art to advocate for LGBTQ+ acceptance and inclusion
nodes.body: Caroline uses her art as LGBTQ+ advocacy. She said: 'Representing inclusivity and diversity in my art is important to me. I also use it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and push for acceptance.' This complements her other activism with Connected LGBTQ Activists and pride parade attendance.

nodes.header: Caroline finds art healing — a way to work through her transition and accept imperfection
nodes.body: Caroline described art as healing and self-discovery. She said: 'Art's allowed me to explore my transition and my changing body. It's been a great way to work through stuff I'm going through. I love that it teaches me to accept the beauty of imperfections.' On 2023-08-23 she reinforced this framing: 'I felt liberated and empowered doing it. Painting helps me explore my identity and be true to myself. It's definitely therapeutic.' Painting gives her 'a sense of freedom.' On 2023-09-13 she added that art is 'so empowering and cathartic' and marveled: 'It's amazing how art can show things that are hard to put into words.' She also said: 'Painting and drawing have helped me express my feelings and explore my gender identity. Creating art was really important to me during my transition - it helped me understand and accept myself. I'm so grateful.' Melanie affirmed: 'Art can be so healing and a way to really connect with who you are.'

nodes.header: Caroline attended a pride parade celebrating love and equality (2023-08-11)
nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-08-11 (Friday before the 2023-08-14 conversation; Caroline said 'I went to a pride parade last Friday'). Caroline attended a pride parade in person. nodes.header: Melanie celebrated her daughter's birthday at a Matt Patterson concert (2023-08-13)

About Matt Patterson she said: 'he is so talented! His voice and songs were amazing.' nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-08-14. During their chat, Caroline shared photos of her paintings with Melanie and explained their meaning. She shared a painting of 'a woman with a cow in her lap' and the 'Embracing Identity' painting (a woman in a red shirt). Caroline explained: 'My art is about expressing my trans experience. nodes.header: Melanie does pottery as a creative activity alongside painting
nodes.body: Melanie takes a pottery class in addition to painting. She signed up for the class on 2023-07-02 and described it right away as 'like therapy for me, letting me express myself and get creative.' On 2023-07-03 she told Caroline she's 'a big fan of pottery - the creativity and skill is awesome. Plus, making it is so calming' and declared 'Pottery is a huge part of my life, not just a hobby - it helps me express my emotions. Clay is incredible, it brings me so much joy!' On 2023-08-17 she mentioned finishing 'another pottery project' (a colorful bowl), and on 2023-08-25 she showed Caroline a plate with flowers that she made 'in pottery class yesterday' (2023-08-24). On 2023-09-13 she described pottery as 'so relaxing and creative' AND 'both a creative outlet and a form of therapy,' and named painting and pottery together as her 'real muses' after seven years of art-making. She combines pottery with painting — decorating her pieces with colorful, eye-catching designs. Her pottery pieces include a black-and-white flower bowl (2023-07-03), a colorful bowl (2023-08-17), a flower plate (2023-08-24), and a set of bowls with distinct designs (shared 2023-09-13).

nodes.header: Melanie is obsessed with colorful patterns and makes art to catch the eye and make people smile
nodes.body: Melanie said on 2023-08-17: 'I'm obsessed with those [colorful patterns], so I made something to catch the eye and make people smile.' Her aesthetic preference centers on bold, bright colors and eye-catching patterns — she applied this to her pottery bowl with a colorful design.

nodes.header: Melanie describes art as a sanctuary and source of comfort, with each stroke carrying a part of her
nodes.body: Melanie said on 2023-08-17: 'Each stroke carries a part of me.' She added: 'I've always felt a strong connection to art, and it's been a huge learning experience. It's both a sanctuary and a source of comfort. I'm so glad to have something that brings me so much happiness and fulfillment.' nodes.header: Pitfalls: Getting started with the adoption process
Steps: Do your research on adoption options
nodes.body: Begin by researching the adoption landscape so you understand what's available and what's involved. Caroline on 2023-10-13: 'Do your research and find an adoption agency or lawyer.' Research sets the foundation for subsequent steps by clarifying what agencies or lawyers exist, what the process looks like, and what to expect.

nodes.body: Do the emotional work to endure a potentially long wait. Caroline on 2023-10-13: 'Don't forget to prepare emotionally, since the wait can be hard. It's all worth it in the end though.' nodes.header: Caroline told Melanie she joined an LGBTQ youth mentorship program last weekend (2023-07-17)
nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-07-17. When Melanie asked what she'd been up to, Caroline said: 'Last weekend I joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth - it's really rewarding to help the community.' She added that she's 'met some amazing young folks and supported them along the way' and that 'it's inspiring to see how resilient and strong they are.'

nodes.header: Caroline told Melanie she mentors a transgender teen and they are building confidence together (2023-07-17)
nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-07-17. Caroline told Melanie: 'I mentor a transgender teen just like me. We've been working on building up confidence and finding positive strategies, and it's really been paying off!' Caroline highlighted that her shared trans experience with the teen makes the mentoring relationship particularly meaningful.

nodes.header: Caroline shared with Melanie that she and her mentee attended an LGBT pride event last month (2023-07-17)
nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-07-17. Caroline told Melanie: 'We had a great time at the LGBT pride event last month.' When asked about the best part, she said: 'The pride event was awesome! It was so encouraging to be surrounded by so much love and acceptance.' She shared a photo of a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air. Asked for a best memory, Caroline said: 'Seeing my mentee's face light up when they saw the support was the best! Such a special moment.' The event referenced is the ~2023-06-25 pride parade.

nodes.header: Caroline announced her upcoming LGBTQ art show next month (August 2023) to Melanie (2023-07-17)
nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-07-17. When Melanie asked about other LGBTQ advocacy coming up, Caroline replied: 'Yay! Next month I'm having an LGBTQ art show with my paintings - can't wait!' This mentions the art show as scheduled for August 2023 at this point (it was later rescheduled to September 2023 as she told Melanie on 2023-08-25).

nodes.header: Caroline shared tree-with-bright-sun painting for art show, inspired by LGBTQ center visit (2023-07-17)
nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-07-17. Caroline shared a photo of her painting for the upcoming art show: 'Check out my painting for the art show! Hope you like it.' The painting depicts a tree with a bright sun in the background. Melanie praised it: 'that painting is awesome! Those colors are so vivid and the whole thing looks really unified.' When asked what inspired her, Caroline said: 'I painted this after I visited a LGBTQ center. I wanted to capture everyone's unity and strength.' Melanie also shared a preview image of 'a painting with a blue and yellow design' before Caroline's reveal.

nodes.header: Melanie told Caroline she and her kids just finished another painting like their last one (2023-07-17)
nodes.body: Timestamp: 2023-07-17. After admiring Caroline's tree-with-sun painting, Melanie closed the chat by saying: 'My kids and I just finished another painting like our last one.' She's referencing the sunset/palm tree nature painting she and her kids did together around 2023-07-08, suggesting a similar nature-themed piece completed around the weekend of 2023-07-15/16.
